messages:
Nina: Quick heads-up 1: Meridian Bank POC goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. They want a clear doc for reserved GPU sizing, autoscale behavior during short bursts, and what we expect them to do for KV preheat. Also asked whether quantized runtime incurs extra licensing.
Ravi: Do we have their traffic sketch? avg vs spike?
Nina: They provided: steady 150 qps embeddings + 50 qps generation; daily spike to ~1k qps for 3-7m; 95p latency budget 150ms for embeddings, 250ms for gen. Business hours SLA Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00 local.
Jules: Sounds like a small committed pool with burst credits. My quick ballpark: reserve for steady + 25% headroom -> ~3 reserved A100-eq. Allow autoscale to 6 with burst credits.
Priya: They insist AZ spread. We can split 2+1 as primary vs failover, but recommend 2+2 for symmetric failover. If budget constrained, document degraded tail when falling back.
Ravi: Licensing note: quantized runtime included under infra fee; legal prefers a line in contract noting "no additional runtime licensing for Redwood quantized inference" so customer sees it spelled out.
Nina: We need an explicit preheat/runbook snippet they can run before peak windows.
Jules: Draft runbook we use: 1) schedule preheat 30m before expected peak 2) run KV replay at 25% peak for 5m 3) run synthetic QPS soak at 50% for 5m 4) verify KV hit-rate >85% then open to production. If step fails, fallback to burst credits.
Ravi: Autoscale policy snippet for presales (copyable):
```json
{
  "autoscale": "enabled",
  "min_reserved_gpus": "3",
  "max_gpus": "6",
  "scale_step_gpus": "1",
  "cooldown_seconds": "180",
  "preheat_window_minutes": "30",
  "burst_credit_mode": "enabled",
  "burst_qps_cap": "1500"
}
```
Priya: Note: cooldown longer to avoid oscillation with 3-7m spikes. Also set a per-customer burst cap so one tenant doesn't consume all credits.
Nina: Pricing: they asked for blended reserved + burst pricing. Presales rules: reserved charged monthly at commit rate; burst credits sold in blocks (hours) at a discounted incremental rate; cross-AZ reserved spread adds a 5% infra surcharge. Ravi, can you pull numbers?
Ravi: I'll attach pricing matrix after this thread.
Jules: Observability checklist for their security questionnaire: per-route token counts, 95/99/99.9 latency percentiles, KV hit-rate metric, preheat job success/failure logs, audit trail for who triggered preheat. All metrics are available in Console and via API.
Priya: Ops note: schedule preheat outside maintenance windows. ops-bot: when's next maintenance?
ops-bot: Next maintenance tonight 02:30-03:30 UTC. :warning: Recommend scheduling preheat earlier.
Nina: We'll move their preheat to 01:30 PT then.
Ravi: Add this to questionnaire answer: telemetry is aggregated, PII redaction happens before metrics storage, logs retained per contract.
Jules: Also recommend we provide a small load-generator repo snippet (k6 + simple KV replayer) so their SREs can run preheat exactly as we do. I'll prepare that.
Nina: Action items: (1) I will draft one-page: reserved sizing rationale + autoscale snippet + preheat runbook + pricing bullets + licensing line (2) Ravi to add pricing numbers (3) Priya to update questionnaire answers (4) Jules to attach KV warmup script and load-gen. Aim to send to Meridian within 3 hours.
Priya: On legal language: propose we include: "Preheat tooling and runbook provided; Customer is responsible for initiating preheat; Redwood will assist during onboarding and provide best-effort preheat support during business hours."
Nina: Perfect. Thanks team. Ping here when docs are in and I'll bundle them into the POC onboarding packet. :rocket:
